app.name: WiiFlow Kids
app.long_description:
WiiFlow Kids is a fork of WiiFlow Lite with a deliberately simplified interface, intended for a young child to use unsupervised.
All Wii and GameCube games appear together in one single coverflow. There is no source menu, no view switching, and no settings, categories, favorites or delete buttons on the child's screens.
Point at a game, press A, then press PLAY. That is the whole interface.
The HOME button still opens the full WiiFlow menu, so a parent keeps access to settings, downloads and game configuration.
Based on WiiFlow Lite by Fledge68.
